title: Titles Screen Correction
whatsNew: Titles now shows one category-specific position card, one qualification line, one countdown, and the standings that establish those numbers.
notes: Removes the contradictory all-category summary that could show first place with zero Boost.
Uses the selected category as the single source of truth for rank, Boost, qualification line, and Boost needed.
Shows an exact 0% progress state instead of a false minimum progress value.
Uses one month-end countdown everywhere and sends Find Challenges to the selected category.
Hides incomplete past-championship records until a winner has actually been recorded.
